title: Event (fact)
description: Immutable memory of an occurrence — the universal occurrence record. A Task (the in-flight request, a Core entity) resolves by CONVERSION: the Task entity is retired and an Event fact carries the memory, with the terminal verdict in metadata.status (source vocabulary: tada 'completed' | 'cancelled'; gcal 'occurred' on convergence, #31). Required fields stay minimal — untitled and undated occurrences exist; a field's absence IS the state. Long-form prose never rides the fact: content lives in linked Note facts (contained_by). The fact schema inherits the base Item (uuid/_type/realized_at/canonical_at/fidelity); this projection declares the data fields.

source_id.description: Native occurrence id in the source system — the dedup key (the Event analogue of Email.rfc_message_id / Task.source_id).

title.description: Title at resolution time. Optional: untitled occurrences exist (event.yaml minimal-validation rule).

kind.description: Documented convention 'task' | 'event' (free string, extensible by schema revision).

start_at.description: The slot the occurrence was meant for (ISO 8601 UTC). Absent = floating.

ends_at.description: EXCLUSIVE end (RFC 5545 DTEND convention, matching the Event entity doc) — the ONE interval convention. Sources carrying duration convert provider-side (ends_at = start_at + duration), never both.

location.description: Short structured field — stays inline (not content).

participants.description: Plain identifier strings, emails preferred (Event-entity rules: cap at participants_max, true count in metadata.attendee_count).

event_uuid.description: Optional core_-prefixed link to the belief entity this occurrence realizes (gcal convergence). tada's facts don't carry it: the Task entity is retired AT conversion — the native source_id is the stable join.
